questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: That it had a good university, and that it had marine courses

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Everything was perfect expect I didn't get to take the marine courses, also feel like there should have been a bit more help

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: it was actually a bit difficult

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Not much there was one meeting, that was pretty much it, I had to call around to figure out and get the help with getting in on courses I needed

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Not that great they can defiantly work on that

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It wasn't easy I used Facebook and connections

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It's cheaper then on campus, but also make sure to not get scammed

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I don't know about campus but I lived a great place

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I'm not sure if they mean classes or for the school itself

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: It's a lot of paperwork and it takes time if they mean to apply for the school, but it's worth it

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Not much help I figured out most my self or through the pre departure meetings in Denmark

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Not very, I came for the marine classes and they wouldn't let me in on those, because I have last priority and they filled up super quickly so that kinda suck

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: It's definitely worth it such a beautiful school and I loved every second of being there

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It was great just didn't get my courses

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Because I couldn't take the courses I came for, I took courses outside of my major so those where lower division courses, even though I'm upper division, some had a lot of work load others had less, but overall it's very doable

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It's very different, there is more help at UCLA, office hours, TAs LAs discussion classes, where as at UCPH you are more on your own

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Black holes and cosmic catastrophes, introduction to earth science, introduction to solarsystem and plantes, neuroscience drugs of abuse, human physiology and Oceanography

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: All were pretty interesting
